_comment: Known wire-contract violations (Tools/rfab/check_wire_contract.py). Every entry needs a reason. The check fails on a violation that is not listed here and on an entry that no longer occurs, so this list can only shrink.

known.subject: SyncRfabProgressionEvent::EventKind::WordWallSync
known.reason: DEFECT_REGISTRY M4: shared Word Walls have a server handler, a checkpoint chunk and a client receiver, but no client code sends the event. Wired or removed in WORK_PLAN package 2.4.

known.subject: NotifyRfabProgressionEvent::EventKind::FullLedgerResync
known.reason: Declared for a full ledger resend that was never implemented; the client case is an empty break. Implemented or removed together with M4/M5 (WORK_PLAN package 2.4).

known.subject: RequestCoordinatedSaveLoad::ActionType::LoadPreviousCheckpoint
known.reason: SaveSnapshotService implements the rollback to the previous checkpoint, but no client key, menu or command sends it. Decided in WORK_PLAN package 4.4 (saves).

known.subject: ReviveActionRequest::ActionType::CancelChannel
known.reason: Not a defect: handled by the final else of EncounterService::OnReviveActionRequest, which this rule cannot see.

known.subject: RequestQuestUpdate::StatusCode::SceneUpdate
known.reason: Not a defect: never travels in this message. QuestService uses the value as a dedup-history key for RequestQuestSceneUpdate, which is its own message.

known.subject: CancelAssignmentRequest
known.detail: ClientMessage has no handler under Code/server
known.reason: The client sends it from two places in CharacterService.cpp and the server drops it; the client compensates with m_cancelledCookies when the late AssignCharacterResponse arrives. Whether the server entity created in between can leak is checked in WORK_PLAN package 5.1.

known.subject: NotifySetTimeResult
known.detail: ServerMessage has no handler under Code/client
known.reason: The result of the set-time command is dropped, so a player without permission gets no feedback. Cosmetic; WORK_PLAN stage 7.

known.subject: NotifyPlayerDialogue
known.detail: ServerMessage is never constructed under Code/server
known.reason: Dead type: the server relays dialogue as NotifyChatMessageBroadcast{kPlayerDialogue}, so OverlayService::OnPlayerDialogue on the client never runs. Removed with the other dead protocol surface in WORK_PLAN package 2.4.

known.subject: NotifyObjectInventoryChanges
known.detail: ServerMessage is never constructed under Code/server
known.reason: Dead type inherited from TiltedEvolution: only forward declarations remain on both sides. Removed in WORK_PLAN package 2.4.

known.subject: NotifyObjectInventoryChanges
known.detail: ServerMessage has no handler under Code/client
known.reason: Dead type inherited from TiltedEvolution: only forward declarations remain on both sides. Removed in WORK_PLAN package 2.4.

known.subject: RequestObjectInventoryChanges
known.detail: ClientMessage is never constructed under Code/client
known.reason: Dead type inherited from TiltedEvolution: only forward declarations remain on both sides. Removed in WORK_PLAN package 2.4.

known.subject: RequestObjectInventoryChanges
known.detail: ClientMessage has no handler under Code/server
known.reason: Dead type inherited from TiltedEvolution: only forward declarations remain on both sides. Removed in WORK_PLAN package 2.4.

known.subject: SyncRfabProgressionEvent::EventKind::DragonSoulSync
known.reason: Reserved, not a defect (DEFECT_REGISTRY M2): a 4.1.0 client reports dead dragons with this kind and the server ignores it, because the server now takes a dragon's death from its own alive-to-dead transition (RfabProgressionService::OnDragonSlain). The 4.1.1 client no longer sends it. The enumerator keeps its number so that 4.1.x peers still decode each other; it goes away with the next protocol version.
